With `text-autospace: ideograph-alpha` the effect should match ideograph-alpha.
properties.notes: Implemented subset: ideograph-alpha (and auto) inserts 1/8em between ideograph and Latin letters in measure/paint face runs. Consumer inline_text_spacing.go + inline_paint.go. Test TestTextAutospaceIdeographAlpha.

properties.description: With `text-box: trim-both cap alphabetic` the effect should match trim-both cap alphabetic.
properties.notes: Implemented subset: text-box shorthand sets trim+edge; consumer trims half-leading (and cap/alphabetic edges) on first/last line via lineMetrics (inline_text_box.go, inline.go). Test TestTextBoxTrimBothShrinksHalfLeading.

properties.description: With `text-box-edge: cap alphabetic` the effect should match cap alphabetic.
properties.notes: Inherited. cap/ex retarget over edge; alphabetic zeros under descent when trimming. Consumer inline_text_box.go adjustTextBoxMetrics. Test TestTextBoxTrimBothShrinksHalfLeading.

properties.description: With `text-box-trim: trim-both` half-leading above and below the text box should be removed.
properties.notes: Not inherited. trim-start/end/both drop half-leading on the block first/last line. Consumer inline.go lineMetrics. Test TestTextBoxTrimBothShrinksHalfLeading.

properties.description: With `text-fit: scale` the effect should match scale.
properties.notes: Apply stores none|auto|scale on ResolvedStyle.TextFit but no scale-search consumer (L). Left Unsupported with matrix note for honesty; checklist closed without [~].

properties.syntax: none | start | end | left | right | center
properties.description: With `text-group-align: center` the effect should match center. Chrome does not support this property (no MDN BCD entry), so the Effect cell may look unchanged in Chrome.
properties.notes: Lite: when text-align is start/left, text-group-align center/end/right remaps line origin (resolveTextGroupAlign). Not full group-of-lines shift. Test TestTextGroupAlignCenter.

properties.description: With `text-spacing: trim-start` the effect should match trim-start. Chrome does not support this property (no MDN BCD entry), so the Effect cell may look unchanged in Chrome.
properties.notes: Shorthand stores raw value and mirrors trim-* tokens onto TextSpacingTrim. Trim consumer hangs half-advance of leading fullwidth open punct. Test TestTextAutospaceIdeographAlpha apply path + text-spacing-trim consumer.

properties.description: With `text-spacing-trim: space-all` the effect should match space-all.
properties.notes: Lite: trim-start/trim-both hang half the advance of leading fullwidth opening punctuation at line origin (emitLine). Test apply in TestTextAutospaceIdeographAlpha; hang path shared with hanging-punctuation geometry.

properties.notes: Implicit/auto-height rows via resolveGridRows + gridAutoFixedPt; locks preferred-height growth for fixed auto-rows. TestGridAutoRows.

properties.notes: Legacy alias of column-gap. TestGridGapAliasesMatchGap.

properties.description: With `grid-row-gap: 8px` rows should be separated by 8px.
properties.notes: Legacy alias of row-gap. TestGridGapAliasesMatchGap.

properties.description: With `hyphenate-limit-chars: 6 3 3` hyphenation should need 6/3/3 character counts.
properties.notes: Consumes min-word/before/after for soft-hyphen (U+00AD) breaks. auto components use CSS 5/2/2. Consumer inline_hyphenation.go shyBreakIndex. Test TestHyphenateLimitChars.

properties.description: With `hyphenate-limit-last: always` the effect should match always. Chrome does not support this property (no MDN BCD entry), so the Effect cell may look unchanged in Chrome.
properties.notes: Lite: always|column|page|spread suppress SHY when the remaining tail fits one line (last-line likely). Consumer layoutInlineFloats softHyphenBlocked. Test apply in TestHyphenateLimitChars.

properties.description: With `hyphenate-limit-lines: 2` the effect should match 2. Chrome does not support this property (no MDN BCD entry), so the Effect cell may look unchanged in Chrome.
properties.notes: Caps consecutive hyphenated lines; no-limit is -1. Consumer layoutInlineFloats consecHyphenLines. Test apply in TestHyphenateLimitChars.

properties.description: With `hyphenate-limit-zone: 8%` the effect should match 8%. Chrome does not support this property (no MDN BCD entry), so the Effect cell may look unchanged in Chrome.
properties.notes: Length or % of line width; SHY break only when leftover slack is within the zone (or zone is 0). Consumer inline_hyphenation.go. Test apply in TestHyphenateLimitChars.

properties.notes: Partial: wrap and auto (when column-height set) open multicol rows in the block direction. nowrap stops after one row; overflow columns in the inline direction are not implemented. Test TestColumnWrapCreatesRow.

properties.notes: fill|contain|cover|none|scale-down; paint consumer on block and inline replaced paths. TestObjectFitCover.

properties.description: With `overflow-inline: hidden` inline-axis overflow should clip.
